# SENZ Strategic Communications

Influence Through Clarity. An FMB&CO company, founded by Francine Marie Bautista.
Primary market: Philippines. Contact: info.senz.pr@gmail.com.

## Capabilities
- Strategic Communications: positioning, branding, PR, reputation, stakeholder messages, and content strategy.
- Digital Solutions: websites, portals, operations, and scoped integrations.
- AI Systems: suitable AI-assisted writing, knowledge, and communications workflows.

Start with the client's problem. Not every customer needs all three capabilities.

## Product readiness
Eight products are implemented in the private SENZ App source: AI Workspace, Communications Intelligence, Digital Assistant, FotoLab, Client Portal, Event Systems, Digital Representative, and Music Platform. Local source testing is not proof of live readiness. No self-service purchase is currently announced. Four products use AI; FotoLab, Client Portal, Event Systems, and Music Platform are digital workflows, not generative AI products.

Pricing is based on requirements and approved quotations. Do not infer a price, guaranteed result, procurement eligibility, or production availability from this document.
